genre_archetype: auto-scrolling rail runner with side hooks and lane switching
control_model: left half tap fires left hook, right half tap fires right hook, vertical swipe changes rail lane, tap hold charges heavy pull
core_loop_signature: auto rolling cart reads upcoming rail segment, fires side hook to collect ore or pull obstacles, switches lanes to avoid danger, reaches station, scores cargo, buys cart and hook upgrades
differentiation_axes: moving cart instead of fixed hook turret
side hooks rather than downward pendulum claw
lane switching and rail hazards share priority with resource collection
station target scoring replaces open minefield score chasing
cable heat and cart durability create runner pressure
route chapters and express stations create progression
forbidden_template_reuse: do not reuse fixed gold miner or crystal cave hook field
do not reuse lunar oxygen battery repair loop
do not reuse tower defense rails or moving turret patrol rules
do not use a farm, ranch, card table, or static puzzle board layout
do not collapse the game into one lane or one obstacle type

map_content_budget.play_area_model: three horizontal rail lanes in a side-view auto-scrolling mine corridor with side target walls
map_content_budget.route_or_region_count: 4 chapters, each with 5 station routes and 1 final express route
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: at least 18 rail signs, lamps, braces, crates, pipes, sparks, and tunnel props
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: constant rightward scroll with speed ramps and preview distance scaling by chapter

special_rules: some switches must be pulled before cart reaches fork
cargo wagons slow the cart but increase station payout
risk_reward_systems: optional bonus depot lanes have more ore and more hazards
charging hook pulls heavy rewards but raises heat
late lane switches save time but risk collision

primary_game_art_packs: license-clear rail or mine prop pack if available
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: medium 2D runner animation with moving wheels, hook launch states, obstacle pull states, and impact effects
asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: at least 10 visible families: cart, hook, cable, rails, ore, gems, barricades, switches, hazards, stations
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: rail and mine assets may share industrial texture language, but icon, HUD, cart, side hooks, and station motifs must be unique to this game
